title: The Drift Away | Scenic Stays

description_expanded: Welcome to The Drift Away, your luxurious beachfront sanctuary nestled along the pristine shores of Navarre Beach, where modern design meets the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. This expansive four-bedroom, five-bathroom retreat offers over 3,000 square feet of coastal elegance and can comfortably host up to ten guests. With its sweeping Gulf views, private beach access, and endless amenities, The Drift Away is the perfect escape for families and friends seeking both relaxation and fun. As you step inside, you’re greeted by a spacious open-concept living area that seamlessly connects to a fully equipped gourmet kitchen. Outfitted with an ice maker, Keurig, drip coffee maker, and high-end appliances, the kitchen is designed for both convenience and entertaining. Large windows flood the space with natural light, framing panoramic views of the emerald waters just beyond your doorstep. The master suite is a true retreat, featuring two king beds, dual TVs, a private balcony overlooking the Gulf, and a luxurious ensuite bathroom. An elevator conveniently opens into the suite, providing easy access to all levels of the home. Three additional guest bedrooms each include a king bed, TV, and private bath, ensuring comfort and privacy for every member of your group. Entertainment is at the heart of The Drift Away. Guests can enjoy classic arcade games, foosball, pool, and poker-style card games, or take the competition outside with oversized versions of Connect Four, checkers, and chess. After the fun, step outside to your private walkover and stroll directly onto the sugar-white sands of Navarre Beach, where the turquoise waters of the Gulf invite you to swim, paddleboard, or simply relax. The Drift Away is ideally located less than two miles from the Gulf Islands National Seashore and the Navarre Beach Fishing Pier, the longest pier in the Gulf of Mexico. Local dining, shopping, and water adventures are all just minutes away, making it easy to immerse yourself in the charm and excitement of the Emerald Coast. For your comfort and peace of mind, The Drift Away observes thoughtful guest policies. Guests must be 25 or older to book, and parties, events, smoking, fireworks, drugs, and pets are strictly prohibited. Quiet hours are observed from 10 PM to 8 AM, ensuring a restful atmosphere for all. Whether you’re seeking a serene seaside getaway or a lively beach retreat with family and friends, The Drift Away provides the ultimate coastal haven where unforgettable memories are waiting to be made. 2025 Blue Angels Practice Schedule: These practices are free and can be seen from Pensacola Beach or Ft. Pickens which is a short 13-mile drive along the scenic route from Navarre Beach to Pensacola Beach. September-9,10*,16,23 October-15*,21,22*,28,29* *Indicates Blue Angels Autograph Sessions in the Museum
